note: descriptors: bytes are letters; open creates the file (O_CREAT); read is a process holding nothing; readFd/readAs/statAs: the process's own pending writes on the path merged in (its handles in open order, the flush merge), other processes' not; pid 3 holds nothing; owner 0 = no lease; leases: a lease root is the resolved path; mutations check literal and resolved paths by overlap
